name: omacom/omarchy
title: Omarchy 4.6.0 RC1 lets coding agents run on local models on the machine or across a tailnet, from one agents panel
summary: Omarchy's release candidate adds an agents panel that installs a catalog model sized to the machine in a network-less container, opens it in the bundled Pi agent, shares it over Tailscale, and can split one model across two cabled DGX Sparks. Linux users get local-model coding agents set up from the desktop instead of by hand.

appearances.title: Omarchy agents panel adds automatic switching between Claude, Codex and Grok accounts near a usage limit
appearances.summary: Omarchy's agent tooling can register a second Claude account and switch new sessions to the account with the most room left once usage reaches a set threshold (90% in the example), keeping the current session running. It works for Codex and Grok as well, and the README is in the repo.
